text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever since suffering her injury, Narita 
Brian's race results have been lackluster.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Is this the end for the 'Monster'?"... 
Even amid such whispers, her devoted, 
grueling training almost looked like a 
desperate struggle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Arima Kinen: expectation, anxiety, 
excitement, confusion— The emotions of 
Umamusume, Trainers, and spectators all 
swirl together as one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even amidst this chaos, Marvelous Sunday 
will surely find the Marvelous. The final 
race of the Classic year begins—
